# Architecture + Interface Contracts Checklist: SpeciaelFamily Calendar Task Management

**Purpose**: Validate architecture and interface requirements quality for completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: `specs/001-calendar-task-agent/spec.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all backend-mediated interface boundaries explicitly specified between frontend, backend, database, and agent runtime? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the spec define requirements for ambiguous date-context agent questions, or is this behavior still missing? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for how `creator_name` is captured and reused in a no-login workflow? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Are API versioning requirements explicitly documented for all exposed REST endpoints? [Gap, Constitution §Delivery Constraints, Contract §openapi.yaml]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the term "shared calendar context" defined with clear boundaries for what users can see and modify? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK006 Are error message requirements for agent unavailability and stale task conflicts written exactly once and without conflicting variants? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "backend-mediated agent integration" described with unambiguous request/response ownership responsibilities? [Clarity, Constitution §Core Principle II, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK008 Are coverage expectations quantified with measurable thresholds per layer rather than only naming test types? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Research §Decision 7]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do task uniqueness requirements align across spec, data model, and API contract without mismatch? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Data Model §Task, Contract §/tasks]
- [ ] CHK010 Do ambiguous-question handling expectations align between research decisions and the edge-case requirements in spec? [Conflict, Research §Decision 6, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are agent error semantics consistent between edge cases, functional requirements, and API status codes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Contract §/agent/query]
- [ ] CHK012 Do architecture constraints in plan and constitution align on backend policy enforcement and contract ownership? [Consistency, Plan §Constitution Check, Constitution §Core Principle II]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Are architecture-facing success criteria measurable for interface reliability, not only user action speed? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK014 Can each interface requirement be objectively verified from requirement text alone (without implementation assumptions)? [Measurability, Spec §Requirements, Contract §openapi.yaml]
- [ ] CHK015 Are quality gates for manual CI defined as requirements with clear pass/fail criteria? [Gap, Research §Decision 9, Quickstart §Manual CI Pipeline Validation]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements specified for primary, alternate, and exception flows across all interface interactions (task CRUD and agent query)? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing, Contract §paths]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for partial dependency failures (database available but agent unavailable, and vice versa)? [Gap, Coverage]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for startup/degraded-mode behavior when one container service is unhealthy? [Gap, Quickstart §Startup]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are all listed edge cases converted into explicit requirement statements instead of open questions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for recovery behavior after conflict errors (for example, list refresh and editor state handling)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are boundary constraints for task fields (title length, notes length, creator name length) consistently specified in spec and contract? [Coverage, Data Model §Task, Contract §components.schemas]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are observability requirements specified with concrete log/metric fields and threshold expectations? [Gap, Constitution §Core Principle IV]
- [ ] CHK023 Are security/data-boundary requirements measurable despite the no-login model (for example, access rules and data retention boundaries)? [Gap, Constitution §Core Principle V, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 Are performance requirements for agent response behavior quantified separately from task CRUD latency targets? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria, Plan §Performance Goals]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Are Ollama model assumptions (model selection, timeout policy, fallback behavior) explicitly documented as requirements? [Assumption, Research §Decision 5]
- [ ] CHK026 Are Docker Compose dependency ordering and readiness assumptions captured as requirements, not only quickstart steps? [Assumption, Quickstart §Startup]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the manual-trigger CI scope clearly bounded (what is intentionally excluded from this phase)? [Assumption, Research §Decision 9]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK028 Is a requirement ID/reference scheme consistently used to trace every architecture decision to specific requirement clauses? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001..FR-014, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK029 Are any terms still vague (for example, "clear", "deterministic", "aligned") without measurable criteria? [Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK030 Are there unresolved conflicts between spec wording and research decisions that need explicit resolution before tasks generation? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, Research §Decision 6]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
